summary: Added the deferred collect-staleness health check. The verdict lives in the engine (digest.collect_health + STALE_AFTER_MINUTES=25, one */20 cron cycle plus slack), reading the corpus's already-existing Store.health()['last_collect'] — no new collect plumbing needed, since top --json simply never exposed it. cli._emit_top now ships it as a `health` field in the JSON and passes it to render_markdown/write; the `status` subcommand reuses the same function for a '⚠ STALE' marker so no surface can drift on what stale means. The markdown digest prepends a 🚨 banner BEFORE the empty-items early return — load-bearing, because the 2026-07-05 outage's symptom was an emptied 72h ranking window, so a banner after that return would miss the exact failure it exists to catch. The extension only renders the verdict (per clarification #5): the badge switches to $(warning) + statusBarItem.warningBackground, cleared when healthy, and the two failure paths that previously called idleStatus() (SSH non-zero exit, JSON parse failure) now warn instead — that is the literal outage shape. Unknown health = stale, per clarification #4. TWO CAVEATS: (1) my plan wrongly claimed extension/out/extension.js is tracked — it is gitignored (.gitignore:14), so the npm run compile succeeded and the artifact is current for a VS Code reload, but it is NOT in the diff; I corrected STATUS.md accordingly. (2) Clarifications #1 and #4 conflict: #1 implies quiet-until-deploy, but #4 says unknown=warn and a pre-deploy engine sends no health field, so the badge warns NOW — truthful today (SSH is down) but visible-now, not dormant. Flagged for Kerry.
commands_run: git ls-files extension/out/ && git check-ignore -v extension/out/extension.js

summary: Fixed both MUST-FIX review findings, scoped to extension/src/extension.ts plus regression tests. FINDING 1: collectNow()'s failure path called idleStatus(), which clears backgroundColor and actively erased an established stale warning, leaving the badge neutral until some later refresh; it now calls staleStatus() + bannerCachedDigest() — a failed collect is evidence FOR staleness, not a reason to go quiet. FINDING 2: unknown-health paths painted the badge but left the digest unwarned. Added STALE_MARKER (matching engine/digest.py's _stale_banner headline verbatim), staleWhy(), withStaleBanner() (idempotent via the marker, so failed refreshes can't stack banners and the engine's own banner is never duplicated), and bannerCachedDigest() (prepends the banner to the cached ai-signal-latest.md so an open preview stops reading as a normal digest). All three unknown-health paths now warn on BOTH surfaces: SSH non-zero, JSON parse failure, and valid-output-from-an-older-engine (no health field -> withStaleBanner before writeDigest). Stays render-only per clarification #5: the extension never computes staleness, it only prepends a banner where the engine had no verdict to give. TESTS: 4 new regression tests, each verified to FAIL against the pre-fix extension.ts (via git stash) and pass after. No TS harness exists, so they are source-contract tests — a real limitation I compensated for by slicing the pure helpers out of the COMPILED out/extension.js and exercising them in node (verified: absent/empty health -> stale, old-engine digest bannered, 74.5h renders, re-bannering is a no-op across 3 passes, engine banner not duplicated). NOTE: my first test draft was wrong and the test caught it — the regex swept in collectNow's stats-line catch, which runs on exit 0 (the collect SUCCEEDED, only its stats line was unreadable), so warning there would be a false alarm; I narrowed the matcher and documented that exception. Pre-existing flagged risk unchanged: the badge warns now, pre-deploy, since a pre-deploy engine sends no health field and unknown=stale (clarification #4 vs #1's 'activates once deployed'). extension/out/ is gitignored so the recompile is not in the diff. No commits made.
commands_run: git stash push extension/src/extension.ts && .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest tests/test_collect_health.py -q -k extension  (verify new tests FAIL pre-fix; 4 failed as expected) && git stash pop
node -e "<slice isStale/staleWhy/withStaleBanner out of compiled out/extension.js and exercise them>"
